items.title: Dick Hyman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Ivory Joe, what’s his name, Ivory Joe Hunter; Ruth Brown, whom I’m working with now; Lavern Baker

ctx.x: He was for a while. And Chuck Berry and those guys.

We all — studio musicians were expected to play everything and I found that I could fit into that kind of stuff because I knew how to play boogie woogie and blues piano from my big brother’s record collection. I played a lot of stuff for Atlantic Records — Jerry Wexler and —
What kind of people did you play behind?
